stem_book: If p, q, r are any real numbers, then [IIT-1982] (a) max(p, q) < max(p, q, r) (b) min(p, q) = (1/2)(p + q − |p − q|) (c) max(p, q) < min(p, q, r) (d) None of these
key: b min(p, q) = ½(p + q − |p − q|)
work: p ≤ q: (p + q − (q − p))/2 = p = min; (a) fails when r ≤ max(p,q), (c) fails for p = q = r
